title: Tracker facets: type, priority and size

kind.description: facet for an issue facet, priority for a priority, store for a store a facet may be kept in, adapter-store for whether one adapter holds one store for one facet, reason for why facet-stores reports a store as the one in force.

name.description: The facet, the store or the reason as the interface and the configuration write it; a priority's configuration name, or none for priority 0; for an adapter-store, the adapter, the facet and the store, as <adapter>:<facet>:<store>.

number.description: For a priority, the number the interface carries it as; null for every other kind.

adapter.description: For an adapter-store, the adapter as issue_tracker.adapter names it; null for every other kind.

facet.description: For an adapter-store, the facet; null for every other kind.

store.description: For an adapter-store, the store; null for every other kind.

held.description: For an adapter-store, whether the adapter holds the store for the facet; a configuration that names a store it does not hold is refused. Null for every other kind.

meaning.description: What the facet, the priority, the store or the reason means; for an adapter-store, what the store is on that tracker where the adapter holds it, or why it is refused where it does not.

values.name: type
values.meaning: What kind of work the issue is: a type of the repository's label taxonomy, or a work type where it has no taxonomy; null for none

values.name: priority
values.meaning: How soon the issue matters: a number from 1 (urgent) to 4 (low), or 0 for none

values.name: size
values.meaning: How much work the issue is: a label of the taxonomy's size group, null for none; a repository whose taxonomy has no size group has no size facet, and an epic is asked no size

values.name: none
values.meaning: No priority: the issue is unranked, not low, so a pool that holds it cannot be worked in order; a filing through the tracker refuses it

values.name: urgent
values.meaning: The most pressing: before every other

values.name: high
values.meaning: Ahead of the usual run of work

values.name: medium
values.meaning: The usual run of work

values.name: low
values.meaning: Behind the usual run of work

values.name: native
values.meaning: The tracker's own field for the fact: an issue type, a priority field or an estimate, each canonical value kept as the tracker's value of its own name unless the entry's values map names another

values.name: field
values.meaning: A custom field the entry's field names, each canonical value kept as the option, text or number of its own name unless the entry's values map names another

values.name: label
values.meaning: A label per value: the value's own name (on GitHub Issues, a priority's is priority: followed by it), unless the entry's labels map names each value's label or its prefix comes before the value

values.name: github:type:native
values.meaning: The issue type

values.name: github:type:field
values.meaning: An issue field of the repository's organization, by name

values.name: github:type:label
values.meaning: A label per type

values.name: github:priority:native
values.meaning: The organization's Priority issue field

values.name: github:priority:field
values.meaning: An issue field of the repository's organization, by name

values.name: github:priority:label
values.meaning: A label per priority, priority: urgent to priority: low unless labels or a prefix names them

values.name: github:size:native
values.meaning: an Effort issue field is a field store (store: field, field: Effort)

values.name: github:size:field
values.meaning: An issue field of the repository's organization, by name, such as Effort

values.name: github:size:label
values.meaning: A label per size

values.name: jira:type:native
values.meaning: The issue type

values.name: jira:type:field
values.meaning: A custom field of the site, by its name or its id

values.name: jira:type:label
values.meaning: A label per type

values.name: jira:priority:native
values.meaning: The priority field, its names given by issue_tracker.jira.priorities

values.name: jira:priority:field
values.meaning: Jira keeps priority in its own priority field (store: native, with issue_tracker.jira.priorities)

values.name: jira:priority:label
values.meaning: A label per priority, named by labels or a prefix

values.name: jira:size:native
values.meaning: each site's estimate is a custom field: store: field, field: <its name or id>

values.name: jira:size:field
values.meaning: A custom field of the site, by its name or its id

values.name: jira:size:label
values.meaning: A label per size

values.name: linear:type:native
values.meaning: Linear has no issue types

values.name: linear:type:field
values.meaning: the Linear adapter has no custom field to name

values.name: linear:type:label
values.meaning: A label per type

values.name: linear:priority:native
values.meaning: The priority field

values.name: linear:priority:field
values.meaning: the Linear adapter has no custom field to name

values.name: linear:priority:label
values.meaning: A label per priority, named by labels or a prefix

values.name: linear:size:native
values.meaning: The team's estimate

values.name: linear:size:field
values.meaning: the Linear adapter has no custom field to name

values.name: linear:size:label
values.meaning: A label per size

values.name: configured
values.meaning: Named by issue_tracker.facets

values.name: kept in labels
values.meaning: Kept in labels because a setting names the facet's labels (issue_tracker.types, issue_tracker.github.priority_labels) or, on GitHub Issues, an issue carries one

values.name: detected
values.meaning: Selected on GitHub Issues from what detection read: an issue's value in the tracker's own field, or, with no labels or values at all, the field the organization has

values.name: default
values.meaning: The adapter's default, with nothing named and nothing detected to move it

values.name: conflict
values.meaning: The facet's labels and values in the tracker's own field are both present and no store is named: store is null, and the facet's reads and writes fail, naming both stores, until the configuration names one

values.name: no facet
values.meaning: The repository has no such facet, as size with no size group, or its taxonomy cannot be read: store is null
